cohort: 500 postmenopausal women aged 45-90 years visiting the obstetrics and gynecology outpatient department of a tertiary health care sector in Gaya, Bihar, India.
finding: Chronic cough, recurrent urinary tract infections (UTIs), and duration of labor were independent risk factors for urinary incontinence in postmenopausal women.
mod_finding: Type of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) was significantly associated with urinary incontinence in bivariate analysis but not after multivariable analysis.
